spans.s:
Thorn,Ⓒs.ⒹkaMwakaH-kaM, SalyaM; SitAgraH, taru-druma-naKaH; (fig.) kaMwakaH, SalyaM; ‘he is a t(horn) in your side’ aMtaH pratyuptaM SalyaM-kaMwakaM-iva sa tvAM pIqayati; ‘there is no rose without a t(horn)’ suKaM nAma duHKamiSritamastyeva, duH-KAsaMBinnaM suKaM nEva prApyate.
Ⓑ
 2 kaMwalakatA-vfkzaH; ‘t(horn)-apple’ DattUraH, DustaraH, unmattaH, kitavaH, DUrtaH, kanakAhvayaH, mAtulaH, madanaH; (fruit) mAtulaputrakaH.
Ⓝ[Thorn]less,Ⓒa.ⒹnizkaMwaka.
Ⓝ[Thorn]y,Ⓒa.ⒹkaMwakAvfta, kaMwakAkIrRa, kaMwakita, sakaMwaka.

Thorough,Ⓒa.ⒹsaMpUrRa, samyac, sAdyaMta, paryApta; See Complete; ‘t(horough)-bred’ aBijAta, atikulIna; (horse) AjAneyaH, kulInaH; ‘t(horough)-fare’ rAjamArgaH, GaMwApaTaH, saMsaraRaM; sarvasAmAnyapaTaH, sarvagamyamArgaH.
Ⓝ[Thorough]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓsamyak, saMpUrRaM, sAdyaMtaM; by pAra in comp., ‘who has t(horoughly) learnt the lores’ vidyAnAM pAradfSvanaH (R. i. 23); ‘t(horoughly) mastered all lores’ tatAra sarvA vidyAH (R. iii. 30).
Ⓝ[Thorough]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹpUrRatA, paripUrti f., niHSezatA.

Thou,Ⓒpron.ⒹtvaM; ‘to t(hou) and thee’ tvaMkf 8 U; ‘do not t(hou) your elders’ guruzu tvaMkAraM na prayojayet.
ⓃThine,Ⓒa.ⒹtvadIya, tAvaka (kI f.), tAvakIna, tvatka, BavadIya, tvat in comp.

Thousand,Ⓒa., s.ⒹsahasraM, daSaSataM; ‘t(housand)s of times’ sahasraSaH-vAraM; ‘in a t(housand) ways or parts’ sahasraDA; ‘ten t(housand)’ ayutaM; ‘hundred t(housand)’ lakzaM; ‘by t(housand)s’ sahasraSaH.
Ⓝ[Thousand]th,Ⓒa.Ⓓsahasratapta (mI f.).
